messages:
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Canary ramp to 10% for release r2026.03.23 started. Monitoring metrics: latency, 5xx, embed-sim.

kate: seeing embed-sim drop on eu-canary, sample outputs look off. dropping similarity vs baseline ~0.18 -> 0.12 on a tiny prompt set. cc @aj @priya

aj: thanks, flagged. can you paste one or two examples?

kate: sure — example prompt + top embedding cosine (baseline -> canary):
```
"What's the refund policy for account upgrades?" 0.87 -> 0.69
"How to rotate API keys in VPC?" 0.81 -> 0.63
```

priya: that's larger than expected. are these all in eu region or global?

kate: mostly eu-west traffic so far (canary region pinned). small sample from ap-south shows similar but noisier.

infra-oliver: infra alerts show no infra pressure (GPU mem/cpu normal). no recent kernel changes on serving nodes.

lina: paging the deploy playbook: do we want an immediate stop and pin previous release, or pause and gather more samples? change window is still open for 30m.

aj: my vote is pause the ramp to 10% (stop further traffic shift) and pin to r2026.03.22 for eu region while we triage. we can keep current canary instances running for debug but stop traffic expansion.

priya: agree. pause ramp now. can someone run quick A/B of prompt set against pinned model to verify rollback delta? I'll run eval harness on the 200-sample prompt set.

lina: i'll initiate the pin and open an ops incident for visibility. @deploy-bot can you pin eu-canary to r2026.03.22 and halt percentage ramp?

deploy-bot: Executing: pin eu-canary -> r2026.03.22; set target_percent=10 -> frozen. Action taken by lina. Job id: jb-87921.

infra-oliver: pin applied, routing rule updated. no service disruption.

aj: thanks. @priya let us know results from the eval (quick metrics: embed-sim mean, median, 90p). if pinned baseline looks fine we'll patch release notes and schedule a follow-up deploy after root cause.

priya: starting the eval now — ETA ~12m. posting results when done.

kate: added a few annotated outputs to the incident ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/incident/jb-87921). rough note: look at tokenization differences too (some prompt truncation on canary variant).

lina: good catch. i'll update release notes draft to mark this release as paused for eu canary and mention rollback/pin. also flag for postmortem if we ship without fix.

aj: wrap-up: stop ramp (done), pin (done), triage (priya + kate), infra confirm (oliver), release notes update (lina). reconvene once eval posts. :thumbsup:

priya: eval finished — sending quick summary: baseline r2026.03.22 embed-sim mean 0.82, canary r2026.03.23 0.67 on the 200-sample set (consistent with initial sample). uploading detailed CSV to incident.

kate: ack. looks like a model-level change (tokenization/embedding head). can we roll forward a patched quantization profile, or do we rollback fully for eu?

aj: we should keep eu pinned to the baseline until a validated fix is ready. if a patch is quick (under 2 hours) we can consider a hotfix deploy with a QA bake. otherwise keep pinned and open for next cycle.

lina: marking eu canary as blocked in the release board and notifying PMs. i'll also add a short note to the changelog for customers in eu saying we delayed the bump.

deploy-bot: Incident jb-87921 created and linked to thread. Canary ramp frozen, region pinned. Notifying on-call SRE.

infra-oliver: adding: we'll snapshot the canary containers for deeper debug (nvprof traces if needed). reaching out to model-onboarding team now.

aj: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for triage updates. if anyone sees regression elsewhere, call an immediate rollback.

lina: thanks — closing the stop/go: STOP (hold) for eu canary until triage complete.
